sections.content_text: Section 99 - Deductions of Tax on any Payment in Excess of Premium on Life Insurance Commission A person liable to pay any amount in excess of the premium paid to a resident in respect of a life insurance policy entered into with a life insurance company, shall deduct tax at the rate of 5% (five percent) on payment of the excess to the policyholder: Provided that no tax shall be deducted on the death of the policyholder.
